_readme: DD's approved case-study library. Source: Master Capability & Service Offering, section 10. Edit here once; each proposal picks entries by id in its own brief (case_study_ids). Keep wording attributable and conservative. Never state a bare multiplier outside the named case it came from, and keep withheld client names withheld.

healthcare-retirement-stack.title: Application ecosystem modernisation
healthcare-retirement-stack.challenge: Disconnected applications across CRM, HR, Finance, Supplier, Risk, Sustainability and Asset Management created data silos and constant re-keying.
healthcare-retirement-stack.result: A unified operational environment and the end of manual data re-keying, delivered from audit and process redesign through to full-lifecycle implementation.

aged-care-transformation.title: Operational transformation with full staff adoption
aged-care-transformation.challenge: Legacy manual processes, non-compliant SIRS and AN-ACC reporting, and staff resistance to change.
aged-care-transformation.result: Full staff adoption, zero SIRS reporting non-compliance and streamlined Care Minutes data capture, through process audits, software selection, embedded PMO/BA, ADKAR change management and workforce training.

early-childhood-workforce.title: Multi-agent rostering with a managed change programme
early-childhood-workforce.challenge: Matching demand and worker availability under strict child-safety compliance requirements.
early-childhood-workforce.result: 90% roster automation, 520 hours saved annually and complete staff adoption.

usg-tradeflow.title: USG TradeFlow / TradesX platform
usg-tradeflow.challenge: Manual, fragmented contractor coordination, paper-based safety checks and slow invoicing.
usg-tradeflow.result: A multi-agent AWS Bedrock framework that achieved 10x job throughput capacity in this engagement, with zero manual data re-entry and automated Xero billing.

ellerston-capital.title: Ellerston Capital reporting automation
ellerston-capital.challenge: Monthly newsletter generation took 78 hours and quarterly fund evaluation reports took 10 days across 15 funds, fed by 14+ unstable platform exports.
ellerston-capital.result: Newsletter generation cut from 78 hours to 1 hour and quarterly reports from 10 days to 1 day, on a serverless AWS data platform covering $1.17B in funds under management at 99% balance accuracy.

civium.title: Civium workforce & grant automation
civium.challenge: Volunteer compliance checks took up to 14 days each, and grant research and drafting were largely manual.
civium.result: Onboarding cut from 14 days to under 48 hours, a 60% reduction in grant-matching and drafting overhead, and 100% automated compliance gating, on a serverless AWS platform in Sydney.

nsw-health-assets.title: NSW Health enterprise asset management
nsw-health-assets.challenge: Disconnected, manually maintained asset records across a large multi-site public health environment created reporting gaps and compliance exposure.
nsw-health-assets.result: IBM Tririga implemented and optimised, modernising asset tracking and reporting across the estate.

legal-intake.title: Fixed-fee legal practice intake
legal-intake.challenge: Manual document handling slowed client intake.
legal-intake.result: An automated NetDocuments API integration that compressed intake 'time to yes' from weeks to under 48 hours.

b2b-health-governance.title: Governance before engineering
b2b-health-governance.challenge: A B2B healthcare procurement platform needed governance guardrails before any system engineering began.
b2b-health-governance.result: A governance roadmap mapping consent, patient records and telehealth AI boundaries, so health-regulation compliance was designed in from day one.
